details: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's recent statements at the Jackson Hole symposium indicated that inflation remains persistently high, potentially leading to a sustained cautious monetary policy or further interest rate hikes. This hawkish outlook has dampened investor sentiment in the cryptocurrency market, contributing to a decline in Bitcoin's price to approximately $78,400. The comments highlight ongoing uncertainty regarding future Fed actions and their potential negative influence on risk assets such as cryptocurrencies.
title: Fed Chair's Hawkish Stance on Inflation Cools Crypto Sentiment

details: Bitcoin is currently trading near $78,000, with market attention shifting toward how broader global Exchange-Traded Fund (ETF) access and a refined approach to attracting retail investors can fuel its next phase of adoption. Experts suggest that expanding international distribution of Bitcoin ETFs, coupled with increased stablecoin liquidity and tokenized real-world asset infrastructure, are crucial for widening participation. Research indicates that emphasizing control, security, and historical performance resonates more effectively with everyday investors than the traditional "digital gold" narrative, pointing to a future where mainstream financial products drive Bitcoin's growth.
title: Global ETF Access, Retail Pitch Key to Bitcoin's Next Adoption Wave
